title: Kernel, evaluation and support maps of a proper pushforward diagram
statement:
Let $(f,g):(C,c)\to(D,b)$ be a proper pushforward diagram of
[def-trf-coefficient-pushforward], with $K$, $u$, $K'=Rf_*K$,
$F_c,F_b$, $i_c,d_c,i_b,d_b$ and the proper $h:F_c\to F_b$ as there and in
[lem-trf-fixed-map-proper]. Use the finite coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$ and separated finite-type
$k$-schemes of that datum. All tensor products and internal Homs below
are derived over $A$. By [thm-sf-ctf-stability], $K'$, $D_XK$, $D_YK'$
and the displayed kernels belong to their finite-Tor constructible
categories. Assume the constructible exceptional admissibility of
[def-trf-admissibility] for every
morphism below that carries an exceptional inverse image (the
correspondences $c,b$ as total maps, the structure maps of $X,Y,F_c,F_b$,
and $f,g,h,i_c,i_b,d_c,d_b$, as well as the projections from the
two product schemes used in external duality). This refers to adjunctions
on $D^b_{ctf}$, with no assumption of an exceptional right adjoint on
arbitrary pro-etale complexes. Put $q=f\times f$, which is proper by
[lem-trf-fixed-map-proper], so that $bg=qc$ and
$q\Delta_X=\Delta_Yf$. Write $\omega$ for the dualizing complexes and $D$
for the Verdier duals of [def-trf-dualizing-complex], and use the
identifications $Rf_*=Rf_!$, $Rg_*=Rg_!$, $Rq_*=Rq_!$, $Rh_*=Rh_!$ for the
proper maps ([prop-functor-package], clause (3)), the units $\eta$ and
counits $\varepsilon$ of the ordinary adjunction in
[fix-prop-adjunctions] (1) and of the constructible exceptional
adjunctions in [def-trf-admissibility]. Use the external product
of [def-trf-external-product] and the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction
of [sk-def-sf-operations] (i). Define:

1. *Kernels.* $P_X=K\boxtimes D_XK$ on $X\times_sX$ and
$P_Y=K'\boxtimes D_YK'$ on $Y\times_sY$.
1. *Trace along $f$.* $\tau_f:Rf_*\omega_X\cong Rf_!Rf^!\omega_Y
\xrightarrow{\varepsilon}\omega_Y$, using
$\omega_X\cong Rf^!\omega_Y$ of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition]
and the counit of $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$. The same recipe defines
$\tau_h:Rh_*\omega_{F_c}\to\omega_{F_b}$.
1. *Multiplication.* For $M,N\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, let $\mu_f:Rf_*M\otimes Rf_*N\to Rf_*(M\otimes N)$ be the
ordinary adjoint of
$$
f^*(Rf_*M\otimes Rf_*N)\xrightarrow{\sim}
f^*Rf_*M\otimes f^*Rf_*N
\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_f\otimes\varepsilon_f}M\otimes N,
$$
where the first arrow is the canonical tensor comparison of
[lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso].
1. *Dual pushforward.* $\chi_f:Rf_*D_XK\to D_YK'=R\mathcal Hom(K',\omega_Y)$
is the transpose, under the currying isomorphism
$\Hom(Z\otimes Rf_*K,\omega_Y)\cong\Hom(Z,R\mathcal Hom(Rf_*K,\omega_Y))$
in the second tensor variable (the convention by which
[def-trf-dualizing-complex] defines $\mathrm{ev}$; equivalently the
adjunction of [sk-def-sf-operations] (i) after the signed tensor
symmetry), with $Z=Rf_*D_XK$, of
$$
Rf_*D_XK\otimes Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\ \mu_f\ }Rf_*(D_XK\otimes K)
\xrightarrow{\ Rf_*\mathrm{ev}_K\ }Rf_*\omega_X\xrightarrow{\ \tau_f\ }\omega_Y .
$$
1. *Kernel pushforward.* With the $!$-Künneth isomorphism of
[def-sf-kv-maps] (i) for $f\times f$, put
$$
\Pi_f=\mathrm{Ku}_!(f,f;K,D_XK)^{-1}:K'\boxtimes Rf_*D_XK
\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Rq_*P_X,
\qquad
\rho_f=(1\boxtimes\chi_f)\circ\Pi_f^{-1}:Rq_*P_X\longrightarrow P_Y .
$$
1. *Evaluation kernels.* Write $\delta_K=e_K:P_X\to R\Delta_{X*}\omega_X$
for the evaluation kernel of [lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality],
namely the ordinary $L\Delta_X^*\dashv R\Delta_{X*}$ adjoint of
$$
L\Delta_X^*P_X\cong K\otimes D_XK
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{sym}}D_XK\otimes K
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{ev}_K}\omega_X.
$$
Here $p_1,p_2$ are the projections from $X\times_sX$.
The first identification uses [def-trf-external-product],
[lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso], and $p_i\Delta_X=1_X$.
The symmetry is the derived tensor symmetry, with its Koszul signs;
evaluation is that of [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. Define
$\delta_{K'}=e_{K'}$ on $Y$ by the same recipe.
1. *Kernel class.* The kernel class of $u$ is the exceptional adjoint
$$
[u]_P:Rc_!A_C\longrightarrow P_X
$$
of $A_C\xrightarrow{\widetilde u}\mathcal H_c(K)\cong Rc^!P_X$, where
$\widetilde u$ is the mate of [def-trf-trace-class-source] and the
isomorphism is the external duality of [thm-trf-verdier-duality]. The
same recipe gives $[v]_P:Rb_!A_D\to P_Y$ for a correspondence $v$ on
$(Y,K')$ supported on $b$.
1. *Support isomorphisms.* $\zeta_c:Ri_{c*}\omega_{F_c}\xrightarrow{\sim}
Rc^!R\Delta_{X*}\omega_X$ is the inverse of the composite
$Rc^!R\Delta_{X*}\omega_X\cong Ri_{c*}Rd_c^!\omega_X\cong Ri_{c*}\omega_{F_c}$
of the right-adjoint form of fixed-square base change
([thm-trf-fixed-point-base-change]) and
[thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition]; $\zeta_b$ likewise.
1. *Composition and exchange.* $\Xi:Rb_!Rg_*\cong Rq_*Rc_!$ is the
composition law of [thm-sf-comp-composition] for $bg=qc$, applied
on these bounded constructible inputs, which are of etale origin by
[lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]. Let
$$
\mathsf E:Rg_*Rc^!\longrightarrow Rb^!Rq_*
$$
be the exceptional adjoint of
$Rb_!Rg_*Rc^!\xrightarrow{\Xi}Rq_*Rc_!Rc^!\xrightarrow{Rq_*\varepsilon_c}Rq_*$.
Use the ordinary direct-image composition comparisons of
[fix-prop-adjunctions] (3) to identify
$Rq_*R\Delta_{X*}\cong R\Delta_{Y*}Rf_*$ via
$q\Delta_X=\Delta_Yf$.

The trace map $\mathfrak t_{c,K}$ specified in
[lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality] has the following construction. Put
$$
\varphi_{c,K}:\mathcal H_c(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Rc^!P_X
\xrightarrow{Rc^!\delta_K}Rc^!R\Delta_{X*}\omega_X
\xrightarrow{\zeta_c^{-1}}Ri_{c*}\omega_{F_c}
$$
Then $\mathfrak t_{c,K}=R\Gamma(C,\varphi_{c,K})$,
with target identified with $R\Gamma(F_c,\omega_{F_c})$ by ordinary
direct-image composition.

split_report.summary: NG independently checked all nine defining clauses against both blueprint snapshots and all eighteen current dependency statements. In particular, the repaired trace-map lemma now explicitly specifies e_K and its global-sections composite: clause 6 and the closing normalization cite and expand that current interface, rather than choosing a map from a bare existence assertion. The ordinary and constructible exceptional adjunction domains, finite-Tor stability, etale-origin comparison, Kunneth directions and signed evaluation are explicit. Fresh Mathlib and project-source searches give no exact full attachment. No proof steps or new nodes are needed.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes clauses 1-9 and the final trace-map normalization of def-trf-kernel-pushforward-maps: main-20261015/sec-trace-formula/sk-d-proper-pushforward (order 2672), identical underlying definitions in master (order 2328). This is auxiliary to the unit proper coefficient-pushforward construction, not its key statement; no realized unit fields are changed. Whole-blueprint searches for kernel pushforward, dual pushforward and support isomorphisms found only this item; same_as is empty.

tool_uses.why: Its finite-level clauses (i)-(vi) ensure all kernels, duals, and direct images are in the finite-Tor constructible domains; this is a generic six-operations domain tool, not a replacement for the proper-pushforward unit construction.
Supplies the canonical finite-coefficient pullback-tensor comparison used in multiplication and diagonal evaluation; the proper-pushforward unit has no separate tensor-comparison statement.
Only ordinary adjunction (1) and ordinary composition comparisons (3) are used; the exceptional adjunctions instead come from constructible admissibility, without its stronger ambient hypothesis.

Its clause (ii) puts finite bounded constructible inputs in the etale-origin domain required by thm-sf-comp-composition; it is a generic domain-comparison tool, not a different proper-pushforward route.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NG-345f8deb3 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the whole item, all 18 current dependency statements (plus the blueprint_update texts of def-sf-kv-maps, def-trf-coefficient-pushforward, def-trf-admissibility and thm-sf-ctf-stability, and def-trf-correspondence and def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory for hypotheses), the source (master order 2328, identical to main-20261015 order 2672) and the unit sk-d-proper-pushforward. There are no new nodes. Every clause has the correct types and directions. Ku_! of def-sf-kv-maps (i) runs Rq_*P_X -> K' boxtimes Rf_*D_XK, so Pi_f is its inverse and rho_f lands in P_Y. zeta_c is the inverse of fixed-square base change (thm-trf-fixed-point-base-change (2), with N=omega_X in D^b_ctf by stability (v)) followed by gamma. Xi is alpha_{q,c}^{-1} after alpha_{b,g}, on etale-origin inputs by lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin (ii). E is the b-adjoint of Rq_*eps_c after Xi and is not inverted. delta_K and phi_{c,K} agree arrow by arrow with the current explicit lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality (zeta_c^{-1} = Ri_*gamma after Bc). The added admissibility of the projections is free by def-trf-admissibility. No cycle: a DFS of the deps reaches 14,082 nodes without returning to the item. No duplicate definition exists in the DAG. Small cases checked: id (chi_id = id), K=0, Spec k with K=A, and A[1] (Koszul sign needed and present). I accept the four tool_uses (ctf-stability, the pullback-tensor iso, fix-prop-adjunctions (1)/(3), constructible-origin (ii)) as generic domain and adjunction tools. FIX: clause 4 said only 'tensor-Hom adjoint', but the cited sk-def-sf-operations (i) curries in the first tensor variable while the Hom variable Rf_*K is second, so chi_f was ambiguous up to Koszul sign. I rewrote it as the transpose under the second-variable currying that def-trf-dualizing-complex uses to define ev (equivalently (i) after the signed symmetry). That is the only change: statement text only, no dependency added or dropped. Corrected file: fixes/dag/nodes/sec-trace-formula/def-trf-kernel-pushforward-maps.json.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
